caption: The video captures a nighttime architectural installation centered on a large arched opening set into a gray concrete wall marked by a regular grid of formwork tie-holes. From the top edge of the arch a thin sheet of water pours down, forming a translucent vertical curtain flooded with saturated blue light. The flow is already underway on the first frame and continues throughout, the brightness and spacing of the individual vertical streaks shifting subtly from moment to moment. Behind and through the moving curtain a slender tree with sparse reddish-orange foliage stands near the center, while a pale curved bar arcs across the opening and a small lamp glows at the lower right. The blue illumination on the wall and water stays essentially constant in hue and intensity. The arched outline, the concrete wall, the tree and the lamp hold their positions, indicating a fixed viewpoint with no object translation. No onset or completion of any action is visible within the excerpt. The falling water simply keeps descending as a steady, illuminated cascade.
